blocks.text:
To: Barbara Blair
Cc: Kelly Snyder, Heather Munoz

I am starting this thread so you have our status on the freedom-to-operate analysis for {{fact:f:E-2020-001.client}} in one place as the work moves. Where we stand: the searching is underway, and we are still fixing exactly what to clear before we read anything against it. Keep the status on this thread and it will not scatter across separate notes.

Kelly Snyder has the reference set open and is keeping it current as the searches turn up patents and applications. We are running the United States searches first, since that is where the products go to market. Heather Munoz, the partner leading the analysis, will review the results before we characterize any of them, so nothing you hear from us on risk runs ahead of her read.

To keep the scope right, we need the current product descriptions and the list of features you want cleared, in whatever form you have them. Once those are in, I can settle the search scope and we will be reading against the right target rather than a guess. If a short call is easier than writing it up, send me a couple of times that suit you and I will set one up.
